description: This file contains functions for translating HTML content within markdown documents, utilizing the goldmark library for parsing markdown and the html tokenizer for handling embedded HTML blocks and tags. It provides HTML translation with skipping certain tags, replacing HTML blocks with translated content, and utility functions for managing replacements.

methods.name: translateHTMLBlocks
methods.description: Main function to parse markdown, find HTML blocks, and replace them with translated versions.

methods.name: htmlBlockSpan
methods.description: Determines the span (start and stop indices) of an HTML block within the source bytes.

methods.name: applyHTMLReplacements
methods.description: Applies a list of HTML replacements to the body string, maintaining order.

methods.name: sortHTMLReplacements
methods.description: Sorts replacements in order of their start positions.

methods.name: translateHTMLBlock
methods.description: Translates the HTML fragment, skipping certain tags and translating text nodes.

methods.name: shouldTranslateHTMLText
methods.description: Checks if a text node should be translated based on its content and the current skip depth.

methods.name: isSkipTag
methods.description: Determines if a tag should be skipped during text translation (e.g., 'code', 'pre', 'script', 'style').
